title: Siman 130
section: His Journey to the Land of Israel

segments.he: לִבְרָכָה אָז מְאד מְאד, כִּי אָז הָיָה אֶצְלוֹ פַּעַם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁרָאָה בְּעֵינָיו אֶת הַמֵּת, כִּי זֶה הָיָה בִּתְחִלַּת יְמֵי נְעוּרָיו. וְגַם אָמַר אַחַר-כָּךְ שֶׁאוֹתוֹ הַמֵּת הָיָה
segments.en: (2.) When he came from Kamenitz he said a Torah on the Sabbath on the verse [Psalms 63]: "My soul cleaves after You" — a very wondrous Torah. And he boasted of himself greatly and said: "And what — when I came only from Kamenitz I say such a Torah! When I come from the Land of Israel, all the more so I will merit to reveal Torah that is more and more awesome" etc.
